description: Selected-account Site Quality Monitoring account, project, token, status and activation operations (10 of 13 pinned functions), available from cPanel 110. Token-bearing responses are sensitive payload data. Single request only; no implicit email, polling, login, URL fetch, retry or rollback. Offline source-backed coverage only: live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.71 remains open. get_monitored_domains/get_monitored_system_scores result locations remain gated under whm-api-client-8x0.1.34; get_all_scores required nullable verbose serialization remains gated under whm-api-client-8x0.1.35. SiteQuality is incomplete.

Creates a monitoring project that bundles URLs sharing a domain. Optional standardAlerting is bool|null: false sends 0, true sends 1, null omits; the pinned null default means no standard alerts. Omitted systemType retains the Website default; supplied strings stay open. URL input is sensitive and is never fetched or locally format-validated. Empty strings remain values. The nested system_type.id is formally untyped (mixed), not inferred from its example/default 1. fixedComponents is a native bool; optional description is string|null. Preserve nested presence, list order and empty systems.

One explicit request and one attempt only. No implicit read, retry, polling, account action, activation email, login, token exchange, URL fetch, restore or rollback. Returned URLs, tokens and data are payload only; API success alone does not establish external application or persistence. Avoid logging token-bearing responses or PayloadMismatchException::$payload.

Creates an external Site Quality Monitoring account associated with the cPanel account. Password is optional and sensitive: omitted/null password lets the server generate one; empty string is sent and is not omission. The source says the system does not save the password. Email is ordinary account input. The optional app_token is a long-lived authentication credential; pinned text says a lost token requires a new account. username is optional string and enabled is optional native bool|null, unlike the integer enabled flag on isSiteQualityUserEnabled(). Registration email and account actions are server side effects of this explicit call; the client initiates no additional action.

Server searches all owned projects for systems matching oldDomain and updates them to newDomain; the client does not loop. Public and form order is oldDomain then newDomain (old_domain then new_domain), intentionally following old-to-new semantics despite the formal source parameter order new_domain then old_domain. Both inputs remain ordinary strings, including empty values. Optional system contains optional integer id, string name, nested system_size with optional integer id/string name, and string url. Returned URL is payload only.
